N10_homogeneous_Poincare.caption_en: Three original homogeneous J preparations on the Poincare sphere; s=2, epsilon=.3, beta=0. Running and bounded phase states show one late cycle at the actual0.5ps saved sampling; the fixed state is a point. s is computed from complex fields using S2=2Im(conj(psi+)psi-), not legacy_s2. No forced normalization or curve smoothing. Orange dot: start; arrow: direction; color: fraction of cycle. Measured periods:344.479051ps (running) and282.408941ps (oscillating); actual sampled intervals are recorded below. The oscillating0D component minimum fraction is0.00384 and the largest unwrapped increment is0.0723rad at0.5ps sampling, so the near-pole passage does not break the phase unwrap. A closed Stokes loop alone does not distinguish phase winding; retain the original theta(t) examples.

N11_spot_Poincare.caption_en: Local center(0,0) polarization of the same three2D runs as N13: J=.040,.065,.100meV; p=13.8, epsilon=.3, beta=.0119meV um^2, identical preparation. Jspot_TETM_J0p04000_refine: T=34.6402ps, Jspot_TETM_J0p06500_fill2h: T=25.0861ps. Orange dot marks the start at2600ps; arrows show increasing time. Color is elapsed fraction of each periodic trajectory only. Fixed state is a point. The final cycle endpoint is evaluated by the validated local8-point polynomial in unnormalized Stokes, then divided by S0; no artificial closing segment or unit-vector normalization. No averaging or replacement observation point. Local Stokes recurrence and temporal interpolation cross-check pass; periods are confirmed returns, not asserted minimal periods. N8 is the starting snapshot of the running case.

N12_spot_J_scan.caption_en: TE-TM spatial scan: p=13.8, epsilon=.3, beta=.0119meV um^2. A_Z is half peak-to-peak of the INTEGRAL population imbalance Z=(N+-N-)/(N++N-). Phase is Theta=-arg integral(S1+iS2)dA, not a relabelled central phase. Two adjacent late analysis windows, each at least max(200ps,5T); they end at3000ps except continued J=.055/.075 at4500ps. Integer-cycle means in accepted periodic windows; actual windows and statuses are recorded per point in spot_J_diagnostic.json. Color denotes phase family; gray is unresolved. Selected J=.040,.065,.100 cases have independently checked matching central classifications. No interpolation across unresolved points. Confirmed rotating and bounded examples bracket a possible transition in(.045,.060)meV; .055 remains locally phase-masked. Bounded-to-fixed transition is bracketed by .070 and .075meV. These sampled intervals are not precise bifurcation values.

N13_spot_regime_dynamics.caption_en: Central observables only at(0,0) for the same runs as N11: J=.040,.065,.100meV, all other parameters and seeds identical. z=(n+-n-)/(n++n-); theta=arg psi+-arg psi-. Three confirmed periods shown for each oscillating trajectory, a comparable duration for the stationary case. Phase is continuously unwrapped; only integer2pi branch offsets are applied. The fixed phase retains its actual value. Central classification is checked separately from whole-map stationarity/periodicity and does not imply the same local phase behavior everywhere.
